title: Junkyard Scavenger's Robotic Ascent
summary: In a derelict landscape of discarded alternators, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls searches for answers. She navigates an insane, volatile world where time has forgotten its purpose, a curious whydah bird her only company. Confronted by a heavy, overgrown vine and baffled by signs of an ancient invasion, she appeals to the universe for a way forward. As the tension mounts, she constructs a lumpy device within a blackened factory's shadow, hoping to subjugate the encroaching darkness. Finally, soaring on a robotic jetpack, her creation injects crucial usefulness, transforming the world and correcting a past mistake.
protagonist: a teenage scavenger with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: In a derelict landscape, a scavenger navigates a world of forgotten time and volatile beauty.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a vast, derelict urban landscape at warm golden hour. A teenage scavenger with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls stands abreast a towering heap of discarded alternators and heavy machinery. Her eyelids narrow as she observes a bizarre, bejeweled whydah bird overfly the scene, a symbol of the insane beauty within the junkyard. Other kalmuck-inspired debris is chucked carelessly around. The air is thick with volatile dust, hinting at recent dejunks and the time-worn beauty of the forgotten.

scenes.sentence: Confronting a pulsing vine, she battles the remnants of an invasion, a bicycle and mailbag her only company.
scenes.prompt: Medium shot of the teenage scavenger with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, grappling with a thick, overgrown vine that seems to pulse with an alien energy. She looks baffled, a radial gasket lying heavy on the ground beside her. An octagon-shaped structure looms in the background, a testament to a past invasion. She's nursing a small injury, her bicycle propped nearby. Nymphs of light seem to taunt her as she struggles onward, dragging a mailbag filled with mysterious components, a silent appeal against impending layoffs. A sense of rapacity hangs in the air, a cosmic jam threatening the universe with its affability.

scenes.sentence: Her hands race, assembling a lumpy device beneath a towering, blackened factory, hope against subjugation.
scenes.prompt: Tight close-up, extreme detail, of the teenage scavenger's gloved hands, still wearing asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, swiftly assembling a lumpy, blackened device. The cracked jade compass on a leather cord is visible around her neck, reflecting the harsh rim lighting. A towering, abandoned factory, its chimney a monument to past majesty, dominates the background, spewing a hasty, anchovy-like smoke. She works joyfully, trying to employ a theory to subjugate the machine, hoping to blanch the encroaching shadows. A landline, inexplicably connected, lies near a pygmy park, its presence a lucky happenstance amidst the madams of industry.

scenes.sentence: Soaring on a robotic jetpack, her creation brings marvelous change, transforming a landscape with newfound purpose.
scenes.prompt: Wide, almost overhead shot, revealing the changed landscape. The teenage scavenger with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, now flies gracefully on a robotic jetpack, an orchid-like glow emanating from its thrusters. The device she built, a trojan horse of usefulness, injects a new purpose into the world. The previous injury is a distant mistake. The once stinky, salty air now carries the faint rhythm of deejays, a marvelous transformation. A newspaper, discarded and archive-worthy, details how this 'psychopomp' originated a crucial ramification, blinding the old ways with a lockjaw grip.
